Healthcare was the best-performing sector in the S&P 500 over the past week, at a time when the broader index lost ground. *   Healthcare stocks have outperformed the broader market over the past week, as investors rotated out of tech and into more defensive plays. The recent momentum highlights the sector's value as a defensive play, UBS analysts wrote Tuesday.1 The sector has outperformed the S&P 500 on 85% of the days when the benchmark was down 1% or more, the analysts said; between Wednesday and Friday, it outperformed tech by the widest margin over three trading days since 2002, according to Bespoke.
